personality_one_liner: A joyful, tactile, and highly physical space that makes family chores feel like a collaborative game rather than a list of demands.

spacing.rule: Make the interface feel touchable with generous spacing and oversized tap areas. Cards should be chunky and well-separated.

dont's: Avoid glassmorphism. This app relies on tactile, chunky, opaque surfaces and soft drop shadows instead of blur.

screens.name: Auth / PIN Login
screens.purpose: Quick access for family members on shared devices (PIN) or standard Google login.

states.error: Shake animation on PIN dots + Red helper text.

screens.layout: Large rounded avatars of family members in a grid. Tapping one brings up a massive, playful numeric keypad (4-6 digits). A 'Login with Google' secondary button sits at the bottom for parent/setup access.

screens.name: Dashboard (Oggi)
screens.purpose: Shows today's assigned chores and allows members to check them off.

states.empty: Illustration of a shiny gold star + 'Nessun compito per oggi! Riposati.'

screens.layout: Top section: Custom greeting with the user's active personalized accent color. Horizontal scrolling list of family members (for parents to switch views). Below: 'Da Fare' (To Do) stacked pill-cards with large icons (e.g., broom, book). Checking a chore creates a satisfying overshoot bounce and moves it to 'Fatti' (Done).

screens.name: Calendario
screens.purpose: Shared family calendar where parents assign chores and members add commitments.

states.empty: Illustration of a colorful calendar + 'Nessun impegno in vista.'

screens.layout: Large, chunky horizontal date selector at the top. Below, a timeline or list of activities grouped by family member. A floating action button (FAB) anchored at the bottom right allows the head of the family to assign a chore, or a member to add a 'Nuovo Impegno' (New Commitment).

screens.name: Classifica (Leaderboard)
screens.purpose: Gamified view of family points and rewards.
screens.layout: Podium-style top visual for top 3 family members with oversized 3D avatars. Below, a list ranking the rest. Tapping a member reveals their earned badges and current 'Premi' (Rewards) they are working towards.

avatar_boy.alt: Smiling cartoon character in a purple hoodie

reward_star.alt: Arrangement with a medal and trophy on a yellow background

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The app is in Italian ONLY. Ensure all hardcoded text (tabs, headers, buttons) uses Italian (Oggi, Calendario, Classifica, Profilo, Compiti, Impegni).

CRITICAL: Implemented a robust 'customizable accent color' pattern per user. Store a user's chosen theme color in state/context and map it to `brandPrimary` dynamically across the app. Provide at least 4 options: Coral (#FF6B6B), Mint (#4ADE80), Sunny Yellow (#FFD93D), and Bubblegum Pink (#FF87A6). DO NOT USE BLUE/PURPLE.
Implement a PIN-based login layout for kids/shared devices alongside the Google Login button for parents. The keypad should use large, chunky, touchable buttons.
Use Phosphor Filled icons at 24-28pt to reinforce the bubbly, tactile, friendly feel.
Make UI elements chunky: buttons and cards should have `borderRadius: 24` or `999` (pill), with soft `elevation: 2` or offset shadows. Avoid glassmorphism.
Apply `react-native-reanimated` for a bouncy overshoot effect when a user checks off a chore (Compito) or switches tabs.

Dual-role functionality: The 'Capo Famiglia' (Parent) sees all members and can assign tasks. Regular members (Kids) default to seeing their own tasks and can only add 'Impegni' (Commitments) to the calendar.
